intent: Fix Vercel deployment configuration error by removing legacy routes syntax that conflicts with modern headers configuration

plan: Understand the issue: vercel.json contains both legacy routes and modern headers configs
Remove the routes section from vercel.json
Test that the configuration is correct
execution_contract.risk: Low - the routes section is redundant as Next.js handles routing automatically

result.what_changed: Removed the legacy 'routes' section (lines 10-15) from vercel.json that was causing Vercel deployment failures due to syntax conflict
result.what_remains: All other configurations intact: name, version, builds, env, and headers. Next.js routing will work automatically without the redundant catch-all route.

impact: Unblocks Vercel deployments for the entire project
